title: Burritos with Black Bean Patties and Grape Salsa
subtitle: with a creamy chipotle sauce
description: Pan-fried black bean patties wrapped in tortillas with a fresh red grape and coriander salsa and a sour cream chipotle sauce.

steps.text: Gently mix the black beans (with their liquid), breadcrumbs, cumin, chilli powder and salt, taking care not to mash the beans too much. Shape into patties, adding a little more breadcrumbs if needed.
Heat a thin layer of oil in a frying pan over medium heat and fry the patties on both sides (carefully, as the beans tend to spit). Transfer to a plate lined with paper towel.
For the salsa, halve the grapes lengthwise and mix with the coriander leaves and the chilli cut into matchsticks.
For the sauce, mix the sour cream with finely chopped chipotle.

To serve, warm the tortillas in a dry frying pan and place on a plate. Put a few black bean patties in the centre of each, add salsa and drizzle generously with the sauce. Fold into burritos and serve immediately.
